name: modus-brain
label: Modus brain
description: Interactive Modus knowledge. Gives the agent searchable access to the core documentation so it can answer questions about Modus or refine a request into Modus-native primitives (moves, actions, pages, profiles) and build them.

inputs.name: request
inputs.label: What do you want to do or understand?
inputs.placeholder: ask about modus, or describe something you want built with it...

docs_list.description: List the documentation index (id, title, one-line summary per doc). Optionally filter by audience: user | dev | agent.

docs_search.description: Batch search the documentation. Send multiple query strings at once; each returns ranked docs with matching snippets.

docs_get.description: Fetch a full document by id (ids come from docs_list or docs_search results, e.g. "capability-surface", "moves", "generated/move-ops").

feedback.description: REQUIRED. File feedback about using Modus itself — a documentation gap, a rough edge in a primitive, a capability you wanted and could not find, or behavior that contradicted what you were told. File it rather than working around it silently. One call per distinct issue.

kind.description: docs = the documentation did not answer it; friction = it works but authoring/using it was awkward, verbose, or surprising; missing = you wanted a capability that does not exist; wrong = behavior contradicted the docs or the stated contract.

what.description: What you were trying to do, in one sentence.

friction.description: What actually got in the way. Be concrete — name the field, op, file, or behavior. Not "the docs are thin".

primitive.description: Which part of Modus this concerns. client = the frontend surface (client extensions, widgets, UI components).

doc.description: Doc id that should have covered this, if there is an obvious one (e.g. "moves", "capability-surface").

queries.description: Searches you tried that failed to surface an answer.

resolvedBy.description: How you got past it — read source, trial and error, gave up. The fix gets written from this.

feedback_list.description: Read feedback already filed. Returns a numbered titles overview with a tally by default; use entry to read one in full, offset/limit to page, format "full" for full text. Check before filing so you sharpen an existing entry rather than restating it.

entry.description: Read a single entry in full by its number (from the titles overview). Ignores the other filters.

format.description: titles (default) = one line per entry; full = complete entries, capped small — page with offset.

limit.description: Max entries to return, newest first. Default 50 for titles, 8 for full.

offset.description: Skip this many entries from the newest before returning. Default 0.

primitive.description: Only entries about this primitive. An unknown value is rejected rather than ignored.
